execution: One offline analysis; no navigation, inference, optimizer construction or solve

bootstrap.interval: percentile 95% for mean and median of paired differences

primary.criterion: upper 95% CI for mean goal-time difference < 0

mechanisms.note: The requested |kappa|>2 indicator is not the executor's |kappa|>8 saturation flag.
mechanisms.time_weighting: Logged controller command intervals clipped to actual termination; active valid non-endpoint PP intervals as denominator. Also report whole-run low-speed fraction.
mechanisms.slowdown: Separate CURV target<0.2 from actual commanded speed<0.2 (acceleration can explain their difference).
mechanisms.heading: Reuse application_measure, 20mm nearest-projection tangent validity. FRESH switch and Graph replacement populations reported separately.

dynamic.public_time: Host publication monotonic timestamp mapped to first recorded 72Hz pose timestamp >= it; also retain original timestamp and capture pose time.
dynamic.passage: First world x > dynamic rear + robot radius; x-axis footprint cleared, not a claim of safe passage. Record subsequent recrossings.
dynamic.intent: Published geometry and current x <= rear + 0.30, verified against SUBMIT public_intent. Reactivation is retained.
dynamic.prior_window: First five INTENT_INACTIVE Graph jobs after first deactivation; all jobs also retained.
dynamic.prior_correspondence: Reuse Graph v4 previous_stencil: B nearest projection on prior then normalized current-path arclength; no new correspondence.
dynamic.side: Reuse side_labels world-X intersection with footprint-expanded halfwidth. Short/non-crossing/ambiguous paths are SIDE_UNDEFINED, not intent conflicts.
dynamic.C1: SUPPORTED candidate only if a corridor-failure run has an accepted post-deactivation first-five correction shifted toward a side-offset prior, closer in lateral RMS to prior than RAW, with actual subsequent outward y motion; otherwise UNCLEAR when prior was applied, NOT_SUPPORTED if absent. Observational association cannot isolate prior causality.
dynamic.C2: SUPPORTED only if forced heuristic side/intent factor remains in inactive jobs; NOT_SUPPORTED if source rebuilds factors each call and logged inactive results contain no heuristic factor. Native side recomputation is separately counted.
dynamic.C3: SUPPORTED candidate if a failed post-passage 3s window moves outward and more than half of valid FRESH endpoints in that window do not point toward the centerline; UNCLEAR if no usable window; otherwise NOT_SUPPORTED. Endpoint direction is a geometric diagnostic, not a counterfactual controller.
dynamic.C4: SUPPORTED descriptive concentration if one adequately observed stage has the greatest nonconvergence count, greater nonconvergence rate than every other observed stage, and failure share > call share. Otherwise NOT_SUPPORTED; insufficient stages => UNCLEAR. SDF enabled is not proof that SDF caused failure.
dynamic.C5: SUPPORTED local conflict if any s=-1 GRAPH job during active intent has a definite native side opposite heuristic side. Undefined paths give no contrary evidence. Attribution of success differences remains UNCLEAR.

plots: Exactly two: first failure by D descending/index ascending y timeline; primary paired goal-time differences.
limitations: Success-conditioned selection; different closed-loop RGB; no prior ablation; solver active constraint row not logged; no causal or online improvement claim.
